Title: Verify that a user who fails the CMS check can retrigger the CMS step and advance to KYC Status 1 after their CMS record is corrected
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- Non-JM market account (KY, VG, GY, or TT) — fresh, not yet KYC-verified
- Test identity available in Ondato sandbox that will pass identity verification
- CMS configured: user initially fails (e.g. name mismatch), then record corrected to pass before step 6
- Ability to verify KYC status in the test environment

Step Action: Launch the eKYC flow and complete Ondato with a passing test identity
Confirm the CMS check triggers automatically — no user action required
Step Expected: CMS check is triggered immediately after positive Ondato response

Step Action: Confirm the CMS check fails; confirm the user is set to KYC Status 8
Step Expected: User is at KYC Status 8; flow stops

Step Action: Confirm the Home screen displays the failure state
Step Expected: Home screen shows the "We couldn't confirm your identity." banner with the "Visit Retail Location" CTA

Step Action: Tap the CTA — confirm the Documents Required screen opens
Step Expected: Documents Required screen is shown with the document list and both "Find a retail location" and "Retry ID Verification" options visible

Step Action: In the CMS test environment, correct the user's record so it will now pass
Tap "Retry ID Verification"
Step Expected: The "Action Needed" modal appears with the tenant-configured wording and "No, go back" / "Yes, I have" options

Step Action: Tap "Yes, I have"
Confirm Ondato is NOT re-triggered during the retry
Step Expected: No Ondato SDK session is opened; no Ondato webhook fires

Step Action: Confirm the CMS check passes and the user is set to KYC Status 1
Step Expected: KYC Status 8 → 1; user proceeds into the remainder of the eKYC flow (eKYC completion screen)
